claims_extracted.claim: The Alto experimental Ethernet was a 2.94 Mbit/s broadcast multi-drop network supporting up to 256 nodes over about 1 km.
The Alto Ethernet implementation consisted of a transceiver, station interface and microcode.
The hardware included FIFO buffering, phase encoding, clock recovery, shift registers and CRC logic.
The Alto manual lists optional BBN-1822, SDLC, BiSync and Async communications controllers and credits Larry Stewart with the BBN-1822 interface.
claims_extracted.notes: Create a separate Alto 1822 artifact record in a later pass.

notes: Use this manual for the mature Alto-era implementation, not as evidence that every listed detail was present in the first 1973 prototype.
